rules.logic: Analytics(MP-034 A Possible Risky Login to Azure) OR Analytics(MP-034 Impossible Traveler SSO for the Shared Principal) on msft_azure_ad_signin AND at least two of Analytics(MP-034 SharePoint Enumeration by the Compromised Principal), Analytics(MP-034 OneDrive Enumeration by the Compromised Principal), Analytics(MP-034 Massive File Downloads from SaaS Service) AND Analytics(MP-034 Exchange Inbox Forwarding Rule Configured) on msft_o365_audit within 3600s on the same user principal (userPrincipalName on msft_azure_ad_signin; UserId / MailboxOwnerUPN on msft_o365_audit) -> one incident naming the principal, the sign-in sources and the forwarding rule.
rules.name: Jingle Thief — Identity and Cloud-Application Stitch on One User Principal
